items.title: Hey, I’m Manojit
items.text:
Senior Consultant – Cyber Risk, Strategy & Transformation

10+ years of experience driving cyber risk, strategy, and security architecture initiatives across diverse environments, with a background in cybersecurity program development, ISMS implementation and audit, NIST aligned assessments, cyber risk management, and cyber maturity evaluations across global standards and regulatory frameworks.

I am currently expanding my focus onto cloud security architecture, DevSecOps, and AI Security, applying risk-based judgment to cloud-native system design, trust boundaries, and security controls aligned with modern engineering and delivery practices.

items.title: Foundations
items.text: Welcome to the Foundations knowledge base. This section covers core computing and infrastructure principles necessary for Cloud, DevOps, and Security engineering.

items.title: Core Topics
items.text:
• 🐧 Linux Systems Command-line usage, file permissions, shell scripting, and systemd administration.

  • 🌐 Networking Fundamentals TCP/IP stack, DNS resolution, CIDR subnetting, firewalls, and routing tables.

  • 📦 Version Control Git workflows, branching strategies, rebase vs. merge, and GitHub pull requests.

items.title: Linux Foundations Overview
items.text: Welcome to the Linux Foundations module. This hands-on path takes you from basic terminal navigation to managing system services, user security, and shell automation.

items.title: Basics & Files
items.text:
Focus: Moving around the terminal, viewing directories, and managing files.

  • Introduction to Linux
  • Paths and Navigation
  • Listing Files
  • Reading Files
  • Managing Files

items.title: Users & Processes
items.text:
